description:
The Software Development Manager is a vital position in our organization as we grow our software development environment and expand our IT department in Mumbai. This individual will be tasked with accelerating the modernization of Medpace clinical and administrative software.

* Manage software engineers and software development projects to implement effective and high-quality software solutions;
* Collect, analyze, and document user requirements;
* Perform project management, ensure system quality and oversee content management;
* Coordinate with company-wide leadership regarding software development projects;

* Train software engineers and end users; and

* Development Experience in web based technologies such as Angular;

+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***




+ Office based environment with on-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities

+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets.  You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.

You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.

* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.

* Proven success in a hands\-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.

description:
****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Java Developer** 
 with at least
 **7 years of Java development experience** 
 and proven experience leading a team of Java developers. The role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering scalable Java\-based applications and systems for large enterprise environments. This position will translate business requirements into technical solutions, support high\-quality software delivery, resolve technical issues, and contribute to innovation through modern development practices, microservices architecture, and cloud computing.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**
* Java: At least 7 years of professional experience developing Java\-based applications and systems.
* Java Development Tools: Experience using standard Java development, testing, debugging, build, and deployment tools.
* Software Development Methodologies: Practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable iterative delivery methodologies.
* Application Development: Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise Java applications.
* Version Control and Collaboration Tools: Experience using organization\-approved source control, issue tracking, code review, and collaboration tools.
* Testing Tools: Experience developing and executing unit, integration, and functional tests for Java applications.
* Enterprise Delivery Practices: Experience delivering Java\-based solutions within a large enterprise environment.


****Preferred****
* Java SE 11 or later: Experience developing applications using Java 11 or a later supported version.
* Microservices Technologies: Experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications.
* Cloud Computing Platforms: Practical exposure to cloud\-based application development, deployment, or support.
* Java Frameworks: Experience with commonly used Java application frameworks and libraries relevant to enterprise development.
* Deployment and Automation Tools: Exposure to continuous integration, continuous delivery, containerization, or deployment automation tools.
* Java Development Certification: Advanced certification aligned with Java development, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Lead, coordinate, and mentor a team of Java developers while supporting effective collaboration, technical growth, and high\-quality delivery.
* Develop, enhance, maintain, test, and deploy Java\-based applications and systems that meet defined business and technical requirements.
* Design and implement scalable, efficient, maintainable, and supportable Java solutions for large enterprise environments.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, development tasks, implementation plans, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve technical issues, manage dependencies, and support informed engineering decisions.
* Apply software development methodologies, coding standards, testing practices, and documentation requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot application defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and production incidents within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to the adoption of microservices architecture, cloud computing, and other relevant technologies where they support business and operational objectives.
* Review technical designs, code, test results, and implementation plans to identify risks and improve solution quality.
* Promote maintainable solutions that use resources efficiently, reduce avoidable processing, and consider sustainability in application design and cloud usage where applicable.
* Track delivery progress, communicate risks and dependencies, and support continuous improvement across the development team.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* At least 7 years of professional experience with Java programming.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, exception handling, collections, concurrency, and application design principles.
* Experience developing, debugging, testing, and maintaining Java\-based enterprise applications.


****Preferred****
* Experience with Java 11 or later.
* Experience with scripting or additional programming languages used to support automation, integration, or application operations.


**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****
* Experience integrating Java applications with relational or enterprise data stores.
* Ability to work with application data models, queries, transactions, data validation, and persistence requirements.
* Experience troubleshooting application issues involving data access, consistency, or performance.


****Preferred****
* Experience with both relational and non\-relational databases.
* Familiarity with database performance optimization, indexing, transaction management, and data migration.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts relevant to application development, deployment, scalability, and support.
* Ability to contribute to Java application delivery in cloud\-based or hybrid environments.


****Preferred****
* Hands\-on experience deploying or supporting Java applications on cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerized applications, scalable services, monitoring, and resource optimization.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* Experience using Java frameworks and libraries to develop maintainable enterprise applications.
* Understanding of application layers, service components, dependency management, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Experience designing or supporting scalable application components.


****Preferred****
* Experience developing microservices\-based applications.
* Exposure to frameworks and libraries used for web applications, REST services, dependency injection, persistence, messaging, or distributed systems.
* Experience applying design patterns and principles that improve application maintainability and reuse.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with source control, code reviews, defect tracking, build management, testing, deployment, and technical documentation.
* Experience participating in requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, release, and post\-production support.
* Experience leading or coordinating development activities within a team.


****Preferred****
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Exposure to automated build, deployment, quality analysis, monitoring, and containerization tools.
* Experience working with iterative planning, estimation, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure software development practices for Java applications.
* Ability to apply appropriate authentication, authorization, input validation, secure error handling, and protection of sensitive data.
* Awareness of secure API communication, access controls, vulnerability management, and organizational security standards.


****Preferred****
* Experience implementing security controls in microservices or cloud\-based applications.
* Exposure to secure coding assessments, application security testing, encryption practices, and security reviews.


****Experience Requirements****
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development.
* Proven experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of Java developers.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering Java\-based applications and systems in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and guiding implementation through development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture and cloud computing is preferred.
* Experience resolving technical issues, supporting production applications, and meeting delivery timelines.
* Industry or domain experience relevant to the assigned business environment is preferred but not required unless specified for a particular project.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience demonstrating comparable Java development expertise, technical leadership, enterprise delivery, and successful implementation outcomes.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Lead and mentor a team of Java developers, assign or coordinate development activities, review technical work, and support delivery quality.
* Analyze business requirements, participate in design and planning discussions, and translate requirements into Java\-based technical solutions.
* Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Java applications while monitoring delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement new technologies, make decisions within approved technical standards, and deliver maintainable solutions within agreed timelines.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development, including experience delivering enterprise Java applications and systems.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring Java developers and coordinating technical delivery activities.
* Advanced Java development certification, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification, is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, technology learning, certification opportunities, and evolving software engineering practices.


**Professional Competencies**
* Apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to assess requirements, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and implement effective technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through mentoring, constructive feedback, work coordination, knowledge sharing, and support for team delivery.
* Communicate technical information, delivery progress, risks, decisions, and issues clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, delivery priorities, and enterprise constraints while maintaining solution quality.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve application design, development efficiency, automation, scalability, maintainability, and responsible use of technology resources.
* Manage time and priorities across team leadership, requirements analysis, development, testing, issue resolution, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery commitments.
